prompt.zh-CN: 理想气体自由绝热膨胀到真空时，若气体符合理想气体模型，温度怎样变化？
prompt.en-US: For an ideal gas freely expanding adiabatically into vacuum, how does its temperature change under the ideal gas model?

text.zh-CN: 升高，因为分子平均动能增加
text.en-US: It increases because average molecular kinetic energy increases

text.zh-CN: 不变，因为内能只由温度决定且无功无热
text.en-US: It remains unchanged because internal energy depends only on temperature and there is no work or heat

text.zh-CN: 降低，因为气体对外做膨胀功
text.en-US: It decreases because the gas does expansion work on the surroundings

text.zh-CN: 变化取决于初始压强，但一定不守恒
text.en-US: It depends on initial pressure, but internal energy is never conserved

reveal.zh-CN: 答案是 B。理想气体自由膨胀时 Q=0、W=0，因此内能不变；理想气体内能只由温度决定。
reveal.en-US: The answer is B. In free expansion, Q=0 and W=0, so internal energy is unchanged; for an ideal gas, internal energy depends only on temperature.

prompt.zh-CN: 空气中肥皂膜反射光出现某一波长的暗纹，关键原因最接近哪一项？
prompt.en-US: A soap film in air shows a dark reflected fringe for a wavelength. Which reason is closest?

text.zh-CN: 两束反射光总是同相叠加
text.en-US: The two reflected rays are always in phase

text.zh-CN: 反射光存在相位变化和光程差，导致相消干涉
text.en-US: Reflected rays have phase changes and path difference, causing destructive interference

text.zh-CN: 光在薄膜中完全被吸收
text.en-US: The light is completely absorbed in the film

text.zh-CN: 只有折射光会发生干涉，反射光不会
text.en-US: Only refracted light interferes; reflected light does not

reveal.zh-CN: 答案是 B。薄膜干涉要同时考虑反射相位跃变和膜内往返光程差。
reveal.en-US: The answer is B. Thin-film interference must account for reflection phase shifts and round-trip optical path difference in the film.

prompt.en-US: If a positive charge moves parallel to a magnetic field, what is the magnitude of the magnetic Lorentz force on it?

reveal.zh-CN: 答案是 0。磁场力大小为 qvB sinθ，平行时 θ=0。
reveal.en-US: The answer is 0. The magnetic force magnitude is qvB sinθ, and θ=0 when velocity is parallel to the field.

prompt.zh-CN: 弹簧振子阻尼系统中，临界阻尼最接近哪种状态？
prompt.en-US: In a damped spring oscillator, critical damping is closest to which state?

text.zh-CN: 系统永远保持匀速运动
text.en-US: The system moves at constant speed forever

text.zh-CN: 不发生振荡并以最快方式回到平衡附近
text.en-US: It returns near equilibrium as fast as possible without oscillating

text.zh-CN: 频率一定变为原来的两倍

reveal.zh-CN: 答案是 B。临界阻尼位于欠阻尼振荡和过阻尼缓慢返回之间。
reveal.en-US: The answer is B. Critical damping lies between underdamped oscillation and overdamped slow return.

text.zh-CN: 两个事件的光信号是否同时到达观察者

text.zh-CN: 观察者所在惯性参考系
两个事件之间的空间距离是否为零

text.zh-CN: 观察者是否处在加速参考系
text.en-US: Whether the observer is in an accelerated frame
